instruction: Pick up the two T-shaped blocks, swap their positions, and place them back with the correct orientations.

arguments.note: The red T points left from its crossbar; the blue T points diagonally toward the front-right. I begin turning both tools downward while preserving these original orientations.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I approach above the two blocks and finish orienting the jaws downward for a clearer alignment view.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 35 waypoints (1.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I lower above the blocks and align each jaw opening across its narrow stem, keeping well clear of the tabletop.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 31 waypoints (1.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wrist views show both stems offset toward the front of the table. I translate above them before making the final descent.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Both blocks remain undisturbed. I bring each tool closer to the narrow stem, leaving clearance for a final camera-guided adjustment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The red stem is centered between its jaws; the blue stem needs a small diagonal centering adjustment. I descend to just above grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Both narrow stems lie between the jaws. I make a final four-millimetre descent and close both grippers.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Both grippers stopped on the stems. I lift the blocks to different heights so their exchange can be collision-free.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 18 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Both blocks lifted securely. I carry the higher blue T above the red T toward the red block's original position.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The full crossing reach was refused, so I split it into a shorter intermediate motion while retaining vertical clearance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The arms crowded each other during the crossing. I move the blue block toward the front to create a separate transport lane.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The blocks are now separated. I start rotating them toward each other's remembered orientations in moderate increments.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 26 waypoints (1.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I continue the rotations; the blue block's stem will point left like the original red block.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 28 waypoints (1.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I finish turning the red block so its stem points diagonally front-right, matching the blue block's original orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 27 waypoints (1.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: With the blue block held in the front lane, I carry the red block over to the blue block's original tabletop location.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I move the waiting blue block farther to the right to clear the working arm and uncover the placement area.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 14 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I lower the red T over the remembered blue-block pose, stopping just above the table for a gentle landing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I ease the held red block down another five millimetres toward contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I lower the red block the final few millimetres and release it at the swapped pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 5 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The red block is released. I lift the empty left hand vertically before moving it out of the right arm's route.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The red T now occupies the blue T's original pose. I withdraw the left arm toward home and partially unwind its wrist.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The left arm is clear. I bring the blue T above the red block's original location, preserving its left-pointing stem.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 31 waypoints (1.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I lower the blue block close to the tabletop while returning the clear left wrist halfway to its starting orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 23 waypoints (0.9s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I lower the blue block another five millimetres for a controlled landing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I complete the blue block's landing and open the gripper, leaving its crossbar on the right and stem pointing left.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 5 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Both blocks are now placed. I lift the right hand clear before its return motion.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I return the right arm toward its starting position with a partial wrist reset, while completing the left arm's home orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 30 waypoints (1.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Both T blocks match the swapped positions and orientations. I finish restoring the right wrist to its original pose.

calls.tool_result: right arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The exact final wrist reset was refused. I use a smaller rotation to bring the right tool close to its original horizontal orientation.
